evidence_route: native collector egress before gateway ingestion
limitations: All attribute values, sample values, timestamps and span IDs are elided; shapes preserve original attribute placement.
Metric names, units, scope metadata and schema URLs are retained as observed, including empty fields.
This Kubernetes validation path does not establish the standalone host path or selectable synthetic construct acceptance.
The sums are observed after delta-to-cumulative processing; they do not prove the receiver input temporality.
Logs are excluded because the Alloy component has no routable logs output.
Post-gateway comparison uses the earlier retained single-family read-back; the new gcx query proves named metric ingestion only, not trace ingestion.
promotion_status: reviewed envelope evidence; not a corpus producer projection
